Messages.Author: ceci...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
I noticed that at superior Canine Horde states:

(S) Strike: destroy equipment with First Strike. Usable at long range.

However, Fast Hands does not give a range it can be used at.

Strike: steal weapon. (S) Strike: steal weapon with First Strike.

My questions are:

(1) What range can I use Fast Hands at?
(2) Can I assume that if no range is listed for a strike that it can
only be used at close range?

Paul Cecil
Ramstein AB, Germany

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ceci...@my-deja.com wrote:
> (1) What range can I use Fast Hands at?

Close.

> (2) Can I assume that if no range is listed for a strike that it can
> only be used at close range?

Yes. [6.4.3.2]
